projections.title: Fin-JEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Representation Learning for Financial Time Series
projections.paraphrase: Fin-JEPA maps 22 daily price-and-volume features into 64-dimensional latents with a three-layer MLP, then uses a causally masked Transformer to predict a 10-step future latent window from a 30-step context while SIGReg regularizes the embedding distribution against collapse. Its latent predictions improve on an identity baseline, but a separate evaluation finds that prediction error does not reliably discriminate forward returns.

projections.title: Trading through Earnings Seasons using Self-Supervised Contrastive Representation Learning
projections.paraphrase: CET separately encodes minute-level price-volume sequences and quarterly earnings features, combines the resulting stock-context and earnings-context representations into a joint context vector, and trains that representation stage with InfoNCE-based contrastive predictive coding to maximize agreement with future price-volume latents while using negatives drawn from periods at least five days before announcements. A supervised head is then fine-tuned to predict next-minute up/down/hold movement during the five business days after earnings releases.

projections.title: Fx-spot predictions with state-of-the-art transformer and time embeddings
projections.paraphrase: The study forecasts 10-minute closing-bid returns for EUR/USD, USD/JPY, and GBP/USD with a Transformer encoder that concatenates multivariate FX and cross-asset technical and fundamental inputs with positional encoding and Time2Vec embeddings before self-attention and pooled prediction layers. Its comparison against LSTM and ARIMA tests whether richer multivariate inputs help the Transformer exploit intraday cross-market linkages better than univariate setups.

projections.title: EXFormer: A Multi-Scale Trend-Aware Transformer with Dynamic Variable Selection for Foreign Exchange Returns Prediction
projections.paraphrase: EXFormer forecasts day-ahead FX returns by applying parallel convolutional receptive fields before self-attention to align local slopes across scales, dynamically weighting 28 exogenous covariates, and recalibrating channels with squeeze-and-excitation before a GRU decoder. The design targets return dynamics driven jointly by short-term noise and slower cross-market factors.

projections.title: Denoised Labels for Financial Time-Series Data via Self-Supervised Learning
projections.paraphrase: The pretext stage feeds a denoising autoencoder a corrupted input formed by repeating the raw price series across channels and trains it to reconstruct a smoother moving-average feature matrix. Up/stationary/down labels are then recomputed from the reconstructed price series and evaluated with a downstream SVM and binary trading strategies on daily S&P 500, one-minute Bitcoin, and limit-order datasets.

projections.title: High-Probability Bounds for Stochastic Optimization and Variational Inequalities: the Case of Unbounded Variance
projections.paraphrase: The paper applies clipping to stochastic first-order methods, including clipped-SGD and clipped extragradient variants, so individual noisy updates remain controlled. It proves high-probability convergence under bounded central alpha-th moments, including heavy-tailed regimes with potentially unbounded variance, for unconstrained minimization and variational inequalities.

projections.title: Decentralized Stochastic Optimization and Gossip Algorithms with Compressed Communication
projections.paraphrase: Choco-SGD alternates local stochastic-gradient steps with compressed gossip updates over a fixed neighbor graph. Each node keeps an auxiliary state tracking the compressed information already shared with its neighbors, allowing biased or unbiased compression while recovering centralized mini-batch SGD's leading convergence term.

projections.title: Distributed Momentum-Based Frank-Wolfe Algorithm for Stochastic Optimization
projections.paraphrase: DMFW solves constrained stochastic objectives over a network without Euclidean projections. Each agent combines consensus and gradient-tracking updates with recursive and Nesterov momentum, then solves a Frank-Wolfe linear minimization subproblem over the shared convex compact feasible set; fixed-size stochastic batches are allowed.

projections.title: A Stochastic Sequential Quadratic Optimization Algorithm for Nonlinear-Equality-Constrained Optimization with Rank-Deficient Jacobians
projections.paraphrase: At each iteration, the stochastic SQO scheme combines a feasibility-oriented component based on the local constraint linearization with an objective-improving component restricted to directions annihilated by the current Jacobian. Stochastic objective derivatives feed the latter component, while adaptive merit and protected step-length rules preserve its stated guarantees for deficient-rank Jacobians and infeasible cases.

projections.title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
projections.paraphrase: Adam uses bias-corrected exponential moving averages of first and second raw gradient moments to assign coordinate-wise adaptive steps for stochastic objectives. It requires only first-order gradients and little memory while remaining invariant to diagonal gradient rescaling.
